changelog: Introduced the interactive 'Pick For Me' to help you decide what to watch.
Added smooth loading animations and smart download notifications to the Media Gallery.
Upgraded your Collections view with a brand-new action bar and tab navigation.

features.title: What's New
items: Added 'Pick For Me' with interactive slot animations to pick a random movie or show.
Added elegant shimmer loading effects when opening the Media Gallery.
Added instant download notifications telling you exactly where your wallpapers are saved.
Enhanced your Collections view with a dynamic action bar and improved tab navigation.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Smarter automatic file naming when downloading wallpapers.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an app crash in Update Checker when internet connection is lost or offline.
